source.context_raw:
passage 1:1 Bake for 20 minutes, then flip the tofu and fries, and then bake for another 15-20 minutes until crispy. 2  Remove tofu and broil the fries for a few minutes, watching carefully, until golden and charred in some spots. 3  Remove and serve with ketchup!

passage 2:1 Bake tofu on middle rack and fries on bottom rack at 400F. 2  Bake for 20 minutes, then flip the tofu and fries, and then bake for another 15-20 minutes until crispy. 3  Remove tofu and broil the fries for a few minutes, watching carefully, until golden and charred in some spots. 4  Remove and serve with ketchup!

passage 3:Directions. Preheat over to 400 degrees. Slice Tofu into 1 x 1 x 3 in. sticks. In a medium bowl, mix together flour, garlic powder, salt and pepper and set aside. Add beaten eggs to a small bowl, and cornflakes to a third bowl. To coat Tofu sticks, lightly roll in seasoned flour, dip in egg, and roll in cornflakes, turning to coat all sides. Repeat for remaining Tofu sticks and place on baking sheet. Bake for approximately 15 minutes, or until golden brown and crispy.

2  Remove tofu and broil the fries for a few minutes, watching carefully, until golden and charred in some spots.
passage 2:1 Bake tofu on middle rack and fries on bottom rack at 400F.
2  Bake for 20 minutes, then flip the tofu and fries, and then bake for another 15-20 minutes until crispy.
3  Remove tofu and broil the fries for a few minutes, watching carefully, until golden and charred in some spots.
Slice Tofu into 1 x 1 x 3 in.
In a medium bowl, mix together flour, garlic powder, salt and pepper and set aside.
Add beaten eggs to a small bowl, and cornflakes to a third bowl.
To coat Tofu sticks, lightly roll in seasoned flour, dip in egg, and roll in cornflakes, turning to coat all sides.
Repeat for remaining Tofu sticks and place on baking sheet.
Bake for approximately 15 minutes, or until golden brown and crispy.
